title: Industrial Design Intern (Spring 2027)
note: Medical-device industrial design internship; the combined posting says Key Tech is hiring for a Spring 2027 (January–April) intern and will review summer applications in the spring.

facts.summary: Industrial design internship at a Baltimore product-development firm that designs medical and lab devices.
facts.duties: Usability workflows, ergonomics and form design for high-tech products such as surgical tools and home medical devices, with some UI storyboarding.
facts.requirements: Industrial design student with a portfolio.
facts.apply: Apply on Key Tech's Trakstar page and upload a PDF portfolio or a portfolio link.
